home.heroTitlePrefix: Personal safety and rapid SOS dispatch
home.heroSub: SafeHaven broadcasts verified GPS coordinates to five priority contacts, links directly to Bangladesh national helplines, and preserves audio and camera evidence.
home.tapToTrigger: Hold for 3 seconds to transmit live GPS coordinates
home.capabilitiesSub: Practical tools for immediate distress alerts, quick escape, and verifiable records
home.cap1Desc: Sends multi-channel distress alerts with live latitude and longitude to up to 5 designated contacts.
home.cap2Desc: Stores trusted family or friend contacts with relationship labels and direct one-tap speed dialing.
home.cap3Desc: Reference guides covering self-defense readiness, commute checks, digital privacy, and legal aid rights.

hotlines.nationalDesc: Toll-free national emergency center for police, fire, and ambulance dispatch.
hotlines.policeDesc: Direct dispatch line for immediate police assistance and incident reporting.
hotlines.womenDesc: Dedicated helpline for women safety support and legal assistance against violence.
hotlines.childDesc: Toll-free helpline for child protection, emergency rescue, and counseling.
hotlines.shasthyoDesc: Government health helpline for doctor consultation, hospital lookup, and ambulance info.

safetyTools.instantToolsSub: Quick escape and responder readiness controls
safetyTools.fakeCallDesc: Schedule a realistic incoming call screen to step away safely from an uncomfortable situation.
safetyTools.medicalIdSub: Key health information for responders and paramedics
safetyTools.voiceSub: Records ambient audio locally with timestamp metadata
safetyTools.cameraSub: Captures timestamped photo snapshots and video clips
safetyTools.cameraDesc: Captures local photo snapshots and video clips
safetyTools.noMedia: No photo or video evidence stored

auth.loginSub: Access your personal safety dashboard and contacts
auth.registerSub: Set up your emergency contacts and SOS trigger
auth.resetSub: Enter your registered email to receive recovery instructions

dashboard.subText: Emergency dispatch ready with linked guardians and live location
dashboard.tapToTrigger: Tap button to begin SOS countdown sequence

sos.sosActiveSub: Your distress alert and live GPS coordinates have been sent to your contacts and dispatch monitor.
